title: Configure GitHub repository secrets and validate the first automated Fabric deployment end to end
description: Load the Service Principal credentials from task-043 into GitHub repository secrets, run the task-045 workflow in dry-run mode, then perform a real deployment and confirm the workspace reflects the committed artifact definitions. Closes Phase 4.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository secrets for tenant ID, client ID and client secret exist and are referenced by the workflow.
A dry-run execution completes and its reported plan matches what is actually in fabric/.
A real deployment run completes green and the workspace shows the deployed definitions.
Dataflow connection bindings are verified live after deployment — deployment success alone does not prove they survived (see task-044 notes).
A full pipeline run after the automated deploy completes successfully, proving the deploy did not break the runtime path.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /work task-spec coherence audit. Spec § Next Steps & Priorities defines Phase 4 (CI/CD Deployment) with concrete deliverables, but the project had zero Phase 4 tasks — verified by a grep probe with a positive control. This task is part of the 4-task set that closes that coverage gap.
OWNER both: Erik sets the GitHub secrets and triggers the runs; Claude reviews workflow output and diagnoses failures.

This is the Phase 4 acceptance gate — spec § Next Steps calls CI/CD 'the one production-readiness pattern not covered by the companion NordGrid project', so this is the task that actually earns that claim.

Spec § Next Steps → Phase 4 deliverable 2 (SQL Warehouse Analytics Layer) is explicitly already implemented — 4 views + 2 stored procedures in oem_wh. No task needed; do not re-scope it into this one.
